settings.title: Home Design
settings.description: Configure content width, desktop top nav, and footer business notice for official sirsoft-basic.

fields.hide_desktop_top_nav_hint: Hides Header board/home/shop tab nav via CSS (official theme compatible).
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_json: Board slugs to hide in header (JSON array)
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_json_hint: JSON array. Empty ([]) shows all boards. Default is [].
fields.footer_link_groups_json_hint: JSON array [{title, links:[{label,href,icon?}]}]. Icons auto-enriched for common hrefs. Empty keeps theme defaults.
fields.business_info_enabled_hint: When ON, shows sirsoft-ecommerce basic_info (company/CEO/numbers/address/phone/email) above the footer. Empty ecommerce info yields an empty block.
fields.header_search_icon_mode: Search: icon only (slide panel on click)
fields.header_search_icon_mode_hint: Default ON. Hides the center search input and shows a right-side icon. Click slides a search panel down (same as feat theme).
fields.header_theme_click_toggle: Dark mode: click to toggle (no dropdown)
fields.header_theme_click_toggle_hint: Default ON. Sun/moon icon click immediately toggles light↔dark. No dropdown menu.
fields.hide_header_board_slugs: Board slugs to hide from header
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_hint: Enter comma-separated board slugs to hide (for example: qna, inquiry). Leave empty to show every board.
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_empty: Could not load boards. Check sirsoft-board and /api/modules/sirsoft-board/boards/board-menu.
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_note: The entered slugs are hidden from every page header (desktop, mobile, and more menu). Related layout caches refresh automatically when saved.
fields.hide_home_box_ids_hint: Tokens map 1:1 to box kinds (e.g. welcome, shop, webzine, or Korean names). Board summary cards accept slug or display name. After hide, remaining cards merge into one `#chd-home-reflow` row (max 3 cols), e.g. Recent | Free board | Webzine. While tokens are active the reflow host is kept across ensures (no destroy/restore fight with SPA remounts). Unmarked cards are collected via card chrome. Empty original grids collapse. Clear this field and save if the home looks empty.
fields.hide_home_box_ids_note: Home (/) only. Each token maps to exactly one box kind. Boards stats card = boards/게시판; board summary cards need slug or display name. custom-ad_slots mounts are never hidden. While the hide list is non-empty, remaining cards stay one row after SPA late mounts; clearing the list or leaving home restores the template layout.
fields.home_custom_html_hint: Inserted under the carousel/hero and above home boxes. Admin-only HTML — paste layout markup, inline CSS, and scripts as needed. Leave empty to inject nothing (no empty gap).
fields.home_custom_html_note: Home (/) only. Placed under the real carousel/hero (including full-bleed mounts outside #main_content) and above home boxes. Forced visible; not affected by home-box hide/collapse. Re-ensured on SPA remounts without duplicate mounts.
